title: AAPF Validation Dataset: Cross-Page-Size ESE Format Changes in Windows Server 2025 and Windows 11
description:
Companion artifacts for the paper "Silent Evidence Loss in Modern Windows: A Detectable Class of Version-Gated Format Change and Its ESE Instance" (Forensic Science International: Digital Investigation, 2026).

Includes: (a) source-level patches for libesedb that resolve the Windows Server 2025 / Windows 11 24H2 itagState reinterpretation failures spanning 4 KiB, 16 KiB and 32 KiB pages with a single format-revision-gated patch (a no-op by construction on databases below the gate; an equivalent fix is in upstream libesedb release 20260704); (b) a Rust-based NTDS.dit analysis tool (Poneglyph v0.2.3) incorporating the patch, plus the Fix 2 ablation pair used in the paper; (c) 22 ESE database samples (ntds.dit, DataStore.edb, WebCacheV01.dat, SRUDB.dat) populated under the Automated Artifact Population Framework on Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2025 and a Windows 11 25H2 client, in Clean, service-stop and Locked (VSS) acquisition states; (d) a self-verifying reproduction sandbox (one vagrant up re-derives the paper's numbers as 69 pass/fail assertions and records the run) together with reproduction scripts and expected outputs.

See README.md for the full inventory and quick-start instructions, and ETHICAL_USE.md for the intended-use statement.
notes: Version 1.1.0 (2026-10-04). The companion paper is under submission; its DOI will be added as a related identifier when assigned.
